subject.title: feat: add /mark command for session label presets

question: Should OpenClaw core own a fixed `/mark` preset taxonomy and per-session reply-language state, or should session labeling remain the generic `/name` contract?
rationale: The branch adds a user-facing command, fixed product vocabulary, localization policy, persisted session state, and a reserved plugin key; code review cannot choose that permanent product contract.

options.title: Adopt core marks
options.body: Sponsor an explicit core mark-state and rendering contract, then require provenance-safe behavior, localization alignment, compatibility tests, and live proof.

options.title: Keep generic labels
options.body: Keep `/name` as the canonical core session-label mechanism and avoid adding preset-specific persisted state until maintainers explicitly sponsor it.

recommendation.title: Keep generic labels
recommendation.body: Keep `/name` as the canonical core session-label mechanism and avoid adding preset-specific persisted state until maintainers explicitly sponsor it.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes the permanent core command and persisted-session contract, requiring repository-level product ownership.
